display.title: Episode 280: Torah, the Best Thing of All, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Children will greet Moshiach first, the 'Ad Mosai' song returns, a guest tells of receiving a dollar from the Rebbe, Rabbi Akiva's priceless cargo, and why we smell spices at Havdalah.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in Sivan 5747. Uncle Yossi presents the summer Tzivos Hashem newsletter and invites children to join and sign up their friends, because Moshiach is about to come and the Jewish children will be at the head of the parade to greet him, ready to ride the heavenly clouds the prophet Daniel describes all the way to Eretz Yisroel. By popular request he teaches the 'Ad Mosai' song again and turns it into the Hakochainik march. An eleven-year-old guest from Ann Arbor, Michigan recites the Shema and tells how the Rebbe gave him a dollar for tzedakah, which brings the Geulah closer. Story time begins 'Torah, the Best Thing of All': on a long sea voyage, wealthy merchants boast of their gold, silver and diamonds and laugh when Rabbi Akiva says he carries something worth more than all of it, which no one can take away. On Mitzvah Time, Havdalah continues: we smell besamim because the extra Shabbos soul leaves, and we begin the week trusting Hashem. Uncle Yossi adds that we count the days toward Shabbos, whose observance can bring Moshiach.
display.lesson: Torah is the one treasure no one can take from you; and keeping Shabbos properly brings Moshiach closer.
